NPC Animations

1170 assets · 1170 animation frames

Family: clover npc animation · Render modes: complete-character · Runtime: 0

Complete-character animation frames. 5 states: greeting (back/front/side x30), idle (back/front/side x30), walk (back/front/side x30), communication (front/side x30 — NO back direction in source), idle_blink (front/side x30). 3 NPCs x 3 directions x 30 frames per state. Derived deterministically from paths. Locked 2026-08-15.
